description: City Council would reaffirm its leadership role in the Homelessness Action Plan.
Council would endorse performance indicators for monitoring progress.
Future budget requests for plan actions would require separate approval.

chips.text: Karen Kobussen argued past plans failed, with 90% of funding serving, not solving, homelessness.
Individuals experiencing chronic homelessness and high-acuity needs are the focus of services.
Administration clarified the city only reaffirms its role
Rob Wilgenhof asked if an immediate triage response team is being developed.
Public delegates expressed varied support for the plan

description: No public report was provided from the in-camera meeting.
The committee met privately for over three hours.
